title: Overview
text: WindUIBE · C++ API Documentation WindUIBE v2.0.1 is an unofficial C++17-first adaptation of the Roblox user interface style for Minecraft Bedrock on Android with Levi Launchroid. The library's C++ API builds the UI model and receives callbacks. The rendered interface is an offline Android WebView using HTML/CSS/JavaScript, connected to C++ through a small embedded Java DEX class. > Compatibility note: The ARM64 module, package, embedded DEX and browser interactions were verified offline; no physical-device Minecraft/Levi Launchroid test was completed. Do not interpret minecraft_versions as a tested compatibility list. At a glance | Area | C++ API | Renderer | Parity with Roblox | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Windows and topbar | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Tabs, sidebar sections | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Nested sections, groups, HStack/VStack | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Button, Toggle, Checkbox, Slider, Input | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Dropdown (in-GUI, no Android picker) | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Colorpicker, Keybind, Image, Code, ProgressBar | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Dialog, Popup, Notify | Yes | Yes | Partial | | Themes (minimal + advanced slots) | Yes | Common CSS slots | Partial | | Localization, key system, assets, resizing | Exposed | Limited | Partial / stub | | Roblox Instance , UDim2 , Color3 , rbxassetid:// | No native Roblox types | N/A | Not supported | Repository layout text include/WindUI.hpp C++17 fluent API include/WindUI.h exported C ABI src/loader.cpp JNI/Android overlay implementation src/Bridge.java reference for minimal embedded DEX bridge src/demo.cpp C++ demo: Main / Elements / Themes / About assets/windui.js offline WebView renderer + event handling assets/windui.html static offline document / CSS shell tools/make_bridge_dex.py generate minimal Dalvik DEX build.sh NDK ARM64 build + levipack packaging tests/ offline tests and host mock examples/ API usage and theme samples docs/ Markdown and GitHub Pages documentation The loader's hardcoded wildcard signature is diagnostic only ; there is no memory patching or Minecraft gameplay hook. Start here Read Quick start , then Windows & tabs and Elements . Use Themes for minimal and advanced theme configuration, Dialogs for overlay messages, and Build & support for compilation and limitations. Interface preview ! The screenshot was generated by an offline browser test, not captured on a real Android device. ! The v2.0.1 menu expands beneath its control inside the WindUI panel rather than using Android's system selection screen.

title: Quick start
text: Quick start Requirements - Minecraft Bedrock Android running under a compatible Levi Launchroid build; compatibility has not been device-validated. - ARM64 Android target, API level 26+. The manifest.json patterns are "1.26. " and "1.26.6 " . - For compiling: Linux, Python 3, and Android NDK r28c ( aarch64-linux-android26-clang++ ). Build and install sh ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/path/to/android-ndk-r28c ./build.sh python3 tests/test_static.py Optional, with Playwright and Chromium installed: python3 tests/test_browser.py This generates dist/libWindUI.so and dist/libWindUI_2.0.1.levipack . Import the .levipack in Levi Launchroid's native-mod manager, enable it, start Minecraft, and tap the movable W button to open WindUIBE. If injection fails, collect logcat and launcher version details; no device compatibility is guaranteed. Minimal native C++ window cpp include "WindUI.hpp" using namespace WindUI; static void changed(int id, const char value, void user) { // Called from the Android UI thread: keep this handler short. } void installUi() { auto window = CreateWindow( WindowConfig{}.Title("My Super Hub") .Author("Native C++") .Icon("wind") .Size(580, 460) .Theme("Dark") .SideBarWidth(200) ); auto main = window.Tab(TabConfig{}.Title("Main").Icon("home")); main.Toggle(ElementConfig{}.Title("Enabled").Value(true)) .OnChange(changed); main.Slider(ElementConfig{}.Title("Volume").Range(0,100,50,1)) .OnChange(changed); main.Dropdown(ElementConfig{}.Title("Mode") .Values(std::vector<std::string>{"Normal","Creative","Advanced"}) .Value("Normal")).OnChange(changed); Notify(NotificationConfig{}.Title("Ready") .Content("WindUIBE loaded").Duration(3)); } Json converts strings, booleans, numbers, objects and arrays into the serialized command stream. Config::Set accepts additional WindUI-style field names: Config{}.Set("Enabled", true) ; the C++ fluent methods use .Title(...) , .Value(...) , etc. See include/WindUI.hpp for exact signatures. Native callbacks cpp void callback(int elementId, const char value, void userdata); value is a UTF-8 string for strings, numbers ( "75" ), booleans ( "true" , "false" ), and JSON-encoded arrays for multiple selections. Callback execution is on Android's UI thread. Do not perform blocking Minecraft operations in a callback.

title: Windows & tabs
text: Windows, tabs and layout CreateWindow cpp auto window = WindUI::CreateWindow( WindUI::WindowConfig{} .Title("My Super Hub") .Icon("door-open") .Author("by RealBatu20") .Folder("MySuperHub") .Size(580, 460) .MinSize(400, 300) .MaxSize(850, 560) .Theme("Dark") .Resizable(true) .SideBarWidth(200) .HideSearchBar(false) .Acrylic(false) ); Values are pixels in a density-independent layout model, not Roblox UDim2 . Size also informs the Android overlay. Some UI window configuration properties are stored but not fully honored by the Android renderer. WindowConfig fields | Group | Available builders | | --- | --- | | Branding | Title , Icon , Author , Folder | | Geometry | Size(w,h) , MinSize(w,h) , MaxSize(w,h) , Position | | Appearance | Transparent , Theme , Radius , ElementsRadius , Background , BackgroundImageTransparency , ShadowTransparency , Acrylic | | Navigation | SideBarWidth , HideSearchBar , ScrollBarEnabled , ToggleKey , Topbar , Footer , OpenButton | | Behavior | Resizable , AutoScale , NewElements , IgnoreAlerts , HidePanelBackground , TopBarButtonIconSize | | Advanced | User , KeySystem | For nested fields, pass Json::Object({{"Enabled",true},{"Anonymous",true}}) to a builder such as .User(...) . Roblox-specific optional fields may be accepted without effective rendering. Window methods window.Tab(TabConfig) , window.Section(SectionConfig) (sidebar section), window.Config(name) , window.Dialog(ModalConfig) , window.Tag(ElementConfig) , window.Divider() , window.CreateTopbarButton(ElementConfig) and window.DisableTopbarButtons(Config) . Setters: SetTitle , SetAuthor , SetIcon , SetIconSize , SetSize , SetToggleKey , SetTheme , SetBackgroundImage , SetBackgroundImageTransparency , SetBackgroundTransparency , SetUIScale , GetUIScale , SetPanelBackground , IsResizable , ToggleTransparency , SetToTheCenter . Window control: Open , Close , Toggle , Destroy , ToggleFullscreen , SelectTab , LockAll , UnlockAll , GetLocked , GetUnlocked , EditOpenButton , OnOpen , OnClose , OnDestroy , OnUserClick , KeyValidator . Callbacks use WindUI_Callback unless otherwise specified. Tabs cpp auto tab = window.Tab(TabConfig{} .Title("Tools") .Desc("Tools available in this panel") .Icon("settings") .IconColor(" ff6464") .IconShape("Square") .IconThemed(true) .Locked(false) .ShowTabTitle(true) .Border(false) .CustomEmptyPage(Json::Object({ {"Title","No controls yet"}, {"Desc","Add C++ elements."}, {"Icon","layers"} })) ); TabConfig also exposes TabTitleAlign . Available tab methods are SetTitle , SetDesc , Lock , Unlock , Select , Open , Close , Destroy , and ScrollToTheElement(element.ID()) . Sections, groups and stacks cpp auto sidebar = window.Section(SectionConfig{}.Title("Administration")); auto settings = sidebar.Tab(TabConfig{}.Title("Settings")); auto advanced = settings.Section(SectionConfig{} .Title("Advanced options").Icon("settings").Opened(false)); advanced.Toggle(ElementConfig{}.Title("Expert mode").Value(false)); auto row = settings.HStack(); row.Button(ElementConfig{}.Title("Save")); row.Button(ElementConfig{}.Title("Reset")); settings.Group().Input(ElementConfig{}.Title("Username")); settings.VStack().Label(ElementConfig{}.Title("Additional information")); SectionConfig : Title , Desc , Icon , IconThemed , Opened , Box , BoxBorder , TextXAlignment , TextTransparency , TextSize , FontWeight . Nested container rendering is supported; individual Roblox layout semantics are approximated by flexbox. Persistence cpp auto config = window.Config("default"); config.Save(); config.Load(); config.Delete(); This is WebView localStorage for control flags, not Roblox filesystem storage. Only elements using .Flag("name") are saved/restored in the built-in control flag model.

title: Controls & elements
text: Controls & element APIs Every Tab , Section , Group , HStack and VStack is a Container . All of them provide the same control builders returning WindUI::Element . Call OnChange(callback, userdata) or OnClick(callback, userdata) on the returned element handle. Supported control builders | Builder | Primary fields | Behavior | | --- | --- | --- | | Button | Title , Icon , Variant ; ButtonText via .Set() | Click callback; icon/variant styling | | Toggle | Title , Value(bool) , Flag | Rounded WindUI pill switch | | Checkbox | Title , Value(bool) | Small square checkmark, distinct from toggle | | Slider | Title , Range(min,max,default,step) | HTML range; value callback on change | | Dropdown | Title , Values , Value , Multi | Expands inside UI; single or multi select | | Input | Title , Placeholder , Password , Numeric | Text input with callback on change | | Colorpicker | Title , Default(" rrggbb") | Android WebView color picker may vary | | Keybind | Title , Value("K") | Listens for DOM keydown; keyboard behavior depends on Android | | Paragraph | Title , Desc , Image , Buttons | Informational card | | Code | Title , Code | Code display and copy button | | Image | Title , Image , Icon | HTTPS URL or bundled icon fallback | | ProgressBar | Title , Progress | Non-interactive progress indicator | | Label | Title | Group label | | Divider | none | Horizontal separator | | Space | Columns | Vertical spacing | See include/WindUI.hpp for the complete ElementConfig field list. Exposed fields such as SearchBarEnabled , AllowNone , Continuous , Transparency , ImageSize , MenuWidth and IconAlign are not guaranteed to have full Roblox behavior. Button and toggle cpp static void clicked(int id, const char value, void ) { / "click" / } static void toggled(int id, const char value, void ) { / "true" or "false" / } auto action = tab.Button(ElementConfig{}.Title("Save").Icon("check") .Variant("Primary")); action.OnClick(clicked); auto enabled = tab.Toggle(ElementConfig{}.Title("Enable feature") .Desc("C++ boolean event") .Value(false).Flag("feature.enabled")); enabled.OnChange(toggled); The demo's Enable notifications setting is now a Toggle , not a square checkbox. A genuine Checkbox remains available for explicit checkbox-style forms. Slider and dropdown cpp // Value range: Min=0 Max=100 Default=50 Step=5 tab.Slider(ElementConfig{}.Title("Volume").Range(0,100,50,5)); auto mode = tab.Dropdown(ElementConfig{} .Title("Select mode") .Values(std::vector<std::string>{"Normal","Creative","Advanced"}) .Value("Normal") .Flag("mode")); mode.OnChange(clicked); // Multiple selections produce JSON-array callback values. tab.Dropdown(ElementConfig{}.Title("Tags") .Values(std::vector<std::string>{"A","B","C"}) .Multi(true)); Dropdown options are rendered as rows directly beneath the trigger inside the scrollable WindUI panel . They do not open the Android full-screen selection dialog. Value can be a scalar or a JSON array when Multi is enabled. Complex arbitrary dropdown object config is only partly supported. Inputs, colors, keybinds cpp tab.Input(ElementConfig{}.Title("Username") .Placeholder("Type your name") .Value("")); tab.Input(ElementConfig{}.Title("PIN") .Password(true).Placeholder("Secret")); tab.Colorpicker(ElementConfig{}.Title("Accent") .Default(" 0091ff")); tab.Keybind(ElementConfig{}.Title("Shortcut").Value("K")); The HTML type="color" picker can still use Android's own picker UI; only dropdowns were converted to WindUI's in-panel rows. Keybind selection relies on keyboard events and is not guaranteed to work with all gamepad or Android navigation buttons. Element handle methods | Method | Purpose | | --- | --- | | .OnChange(cb, ptr) , .OnClick(cb, ptr) | Register native callback | | .Off() | Unregister callback | | .SetValue(Json) , .Set(Json) | Update value | | .SetTitle(str) , .SetDesc(str) | Update text | | .SetCode , .SetImage , .SetColor , .SetThumbnail | Update type-specific fields | | .SetMin , .SetMax , .SetWidth , .SetValues | Change range/layout/options | | .Lock() , .Unlock() | Disable/enable input | | .Toggle() | Toggle state through native command | | .Highlight() , .Refresh() , .Select() | Presentation or action request | | .Destroy() | Remove element and callback registration | | .ID() | Stable element identifier | Some actions ( Refresh , selection on a non-tab element, some settable fields) are no-ops in the current renderer. They remain part of the API surface but should not be treated as fully realized Roblox beha

title: Themes
text: Themes and appearance Minimal theme cpp Theme dark; dark.Name("Dark Custom") .Accent(" 18181b") .Background(" 101010") .Outline(" ffffff") .Text(" ffffff") .Placeholder(" 7a7a7a") .Button(" 52525b") .Icon(" a1a1aa"); AddTheme(dark); SetTheme("Dark Custom"); This is the C++ equivalent of WindUI's minimal Lua WindUI:AddTheme . Hex values use strings such as " 0091ff" (not Color3 ). Advanced theme fields Any advanced property can be added with Theme::Color(name, hex) or Theme::Value(name, Json) . The API accepts the following WindUI-style keys; the current renderer maps the most visible ones to CSS custom properties, with other fields retained as configuration metadata. | Area | Fields | | --- | --- | | Core | Primary , White , Black , Dialog , Background , BackgroundTransparency , Hover | | Panels | PanelBackground , PanelBackgroundTransparency , WindowBackground , WindowShadow , WindowTopbarTitle , WindowTopbarAuthor , WindowTopbarIcon , WindowTopbarButtonIcon , WindowSearchBarBackground | | Tabs | TabBackground , TabBackgroundHover , TabBackgroundHoverTransparency , TabBackgroundActive , TabBackgroundActiveTransparency , TabText , TabTextTransparency , TabTextTransparencyActive , TabTitle , TabIcon , TabIconTransparency , TabIconTransparencyActive , TabBorder , TabBorderTransparency , TabBorderTransparencyActive , TabSectionIcon | | Elements | ElementBackground , ElementBackgroundTransparency , ElementBackgroundHover , ElementTitle , ElementDesc , ElementIcon , Toggle , ToggleBar , Checkbox , CheckboxIcon , CheckboxBorder , CheckboxBorderTransparency , Slider , SliderThumb , SliderIcon , SliderIconFrom , SliderIconTo | | Popups | PopupBackground , PopupBackgroundTransparency , PopupTitle , PopupContent , PopupIcon , DialogBackground , DialogBackgroundTransparency , DialogTitle , DialogContent , DialogIcon | | Tooltips | Tooltip , TooltipText , TooltipSecondary , TooltipSecondaryText | | Sections | SectionIcon , SectionExpandIcon , SectionExpandIconTransparency , SectionBox , SectionBoxTransparency , SectionBoxBorder , SectionBoxBorderTransparency , SectionBoxBackground , SectionBoxBackgroundTransparency | | Other | SearchBarBorder , SearchBarBorderTransparency , Notification , NotificationTitle , NotificationTitleTransparency , NotificationContent , NotificationContentTransparency , NotificationDuration , NotificationDurationTransparency , NotificationBorder , NotificationBorderTransparency , DropdownTabBorder , LabelBackground , LabelBackgroundTransparency | Example: cpp Theme t; t.Name("Advanced Dark") .Color("Primary"," a1a1aa") .Color("WindowBackground"," 101010") .Color("ElementTitle"," ffffff") .Color("TabBackgroundActive"," ffffff") .Value("TabBackgroundActiveTransparency",0.93) .Color("Toggle"," 52525b") .Color("Slider"," 0091ff") .Color("SliderThumb"," ffffff") .Value("PanelBackgroundTransparency",0.95); AddTheme(t); The repository contains a longer field-by-field sample at and the original renderer mapping in assets/windui.js . Built-in presets Dark , Light , Rose , Plant , Red , Indigo , Sky , Violet , Amber , Emerald , Midnight , Crimson , Monokai Pro , Cotton Candy , Mellowsi , Rainbow . The C++ demo also registers Minimal Dark . cpp auto names = GetThemes(); // JSON array encoded as std::string auto current = GetCurrentTheme(); // std::string SetTheme("Rainbow"); ToggleAcrylic(true); // CSS transparency; not a live scene blur Gradient(Json::Array({...}), Config{}) approximates multi-color gradients through CSS. SetFont , SetLanguage , Localization , and arbitrary Theme::Color properties exist, but font availability and localization behavior depend on the renderer. Advanced 1:1 theme fidelity is not verified .

title: Dialogs & popups
text: Dialogs, popups and notifications The C++ API represents confirmation dialogs, standalone popups, and toasts as distinct components. Dialog Dialogs use a modal backdrop and block interaction with the underlying panel until dismissed. cpp static void confirmed(int id,const char value,void ) {} auto dialog = window.Dialog( ModalConfig{}.Title("Confirm Delete") .Icon("alert-circle") .IconThemed(true) .Content("This action cannot be undone.") .AddButton(DialogButton("Delete", confirmed, nullptr, "Destructive", "trash-2")) .AddButton(DialogButton("Cancel", nullptr, nullptr, "Secondary", "x")) ); dialog.Show(); // later: dialog.Close(); DialogButton parameters are (title, callback, userdata, variant, icon) ; supported labels include Primary , Secondary , Destructive and Tertiary . The labels are preserved but visual behavior is not pixel-identical to Roblox. Popup cpp auto popup = WindUI::Popup( ModalConfig{}.Title("Welcome") .Icon("bell") .Content("Welcome to the native UI") .AddButton(DialogButton("Get Started", confirmed)) ); popup.Show(); popup.Close(); Popups render as separate styled windows inside the main UI; they are not Android system windows. Notification cpp Notify(NotificationConfig{} .Title("Success") .Content("Operation completed") .Icon("check-circle") .Duration(3)); SetNotificationLower(true); // show lower in UI, not Roblox jump button detection Notifications are toast-like messages that auto-dismiss. The lower setting positions them near the bottom of the WindUI view; no Android system notification permission is involved. Roblox-specific jump-button avoidance is not implemented. Library API | Call | Behavior | | --- | --- | | CreateWindow(WindowConfig) | Create UI state and view | | AddTheme(Theme) | Register color theme | | SetTheme(name) , GetThemes() , GetCurrentTheme() | Preset/theme control (getter state is C++ tracked) | | Gradient(colors, config) | CSS gradient approximation | | SetNotificationLower(bool) | Toast placement | | SetFont(name) | CSS font-family request | | SetLanguage(code) , Localization(Config) | Metadata; incomplete translation | | ToggleAcrylic(bool) | CSS blur/translucency | | GetTransparency() , GetWindowSize() | Native model information | | SetParent(string) | No-op : Roblox Instance not available | Key system and user config The WindowConfig accepts .KeySystem(Json) and .User(Json) . window.KeyValidator(function, userdata) registers a C++ key-validation callback. Optional local saving uses WebView storage; this is a convenience UI gate, not secure authentication . The Roblox URL /thumbnail behaviors are not fully replicated.

title: Native C++ ABI
text: Native ABI and architecture How the bridge works 1. Levi Launchroid loads libWindUI.so through the preload-native manifest. 2. src/loader.cpp discovers the launcher Android Activity and creates the overlay. 3. C++ uses an in-memory DEX containing the windui.Bridge Java class for Android UI-thread and touch callbacks. 4. The offline assets/windui.html + assets/windui.js render controls in an Android WebView. 5. C++ calls WindUI_Command to send JSON commands to the view. UI events return through windui://event URLs and invoke registered WindUI_Callback handlers. There is no Roblox Lua interpreter, injected Roblox objects, or Minecraft GUI scene graph. This is not a pure-C++ graphics renderer, and Android WebView remains a runtime dependency. Exported C ABI ( include/WindUI.h ) cpp typedef void ( WindUI_Callback)(int elementId, const char value, void userdata); int WindUI_IsReady(void); int WindUI_NextId(void); int WindUI_Command(const char method,const char payloadJson,int persistent); void WindUI_On(int id,WindUI_Callback callback,void userdata); void WindUI_Off(int id); void WindUI_RegisterCallback(WindUI_Callback callback,void userdata); void WindUI_Open(void); void WindUI_Close(void); void WindUI_SetOverlaySize(int widthDp,int heightDp); void WindUI_SetOpenButtonEnabled(int enabled); void WindUI_SetUIScale(double value); double WindUI_GetUIScale(void); void WindUI_SetTransparency(double value); double WindUI_GetTransparency(void); void WindUI_GetWindowSize(int widthDp,int heightDp); const char WindUI_GetCurrentTheme(void); const char WindUI_GetThemesJSON(void); const char WindUI_GetLockedIdsJSON(int getLocked); Other exports: WindUI_SetTheme , WindUI_OnKeyValidation , WindUI_GetDiagnosticSignature ; legacy WindUI_SetTitle , WindUI_Notify , WindUI_AddTab , WindUI_AddButton , WindUI_AddToggle , WindUI_AddSlider , WindUI_AddInput , WindUI_AddDropdown . Native extensions may call these through dlsym if the launcher's Android linker namespace permits access. The C++ convenience layer expects a linked/resolvable C ABI. See examples/native_extension.cpp for a concrete extension. Native event handlers cpp static void onChange(int id, const char value, void userdata) { // value points to an event payload; consume it in this call. } auto tab = window.Tab(TabConfig{}.Title("Settings")); int id = tab.Toggle(ElementConfig{}.Title("Enabled").Value(true)) .OnChange(onChange).ID(); The callback runs on the Android UI thread; marshal to your own worker for expensive work. Avoid blocking WebView event dispatch. JSON and individual values should be validated if they come from dynamic control inputs. Wildcard signature The loader includes a 64-byte hardcoded diagnostic pattern with wildcard bytes for the supplied 1.26.62.1 ARM64 ELF. This pattern is not used to patch memory or hook Minecraft . Do not assume it matches other builds or enables compatibility. Source/API relationship WindUI.hpp declares builder methods and serializes commands. windui.js must implement a corresponding dispatch operation and actual DOM interaction for a feature to work. A declared builder does not automatically mean full Roblox behavior exists.

title: Build & limitations
text: Build, tests and limitations Build environment Use a Linux host with Python 3 and Android NDK r28c. The supplied build uses the Android API 26 ARM64 Clang toolchain. Java source is retained as a reference; tools/make_bridge_dex.py constructs the small embedded DEX without a JDK/R8 dependency. sh export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=/path/to/android-ndk-r28c ./build.sh python3 tests/test_static.py build.sh writes a 16K-page-compatible ARM64 dist/libWindUI.so and wraps it with manifest.json , LICENSE , and ATTRIBUTION.txt into dist/libWindUI_2.0.1.levipack . The stripped library depends on Android system libraries and libc++_shared.so at runtime. Not all Levi Launchroid installations necessarily supply these dependencies in the module's linker namespace. Optional renderer tests sh Requires g++ / Playwright / Chromium Host mock stubs are included for generating test commands. g++ -std=c++17 -Itests/hoststub src/demo.cpp tests/mock.cpp -o tests/demo_host ./tests/demo_host > tests/demo_commands.jsonl python3 tests/test_browser.py The source bundle includes tests/mock.cpp , tests/hoststub/android/log.h , and tests/demo_commands.jsonl so the optional browser test can run independently. The standalone static test runs after an NDK build. A browser test only checks HTML/JavaScript behavior and cannot certify actual Minecraft integration. Verified offline - ARM64 ELF compilation/linking, packaging and ZIP integrity. - Manifest fields, embedded DEX structure and checksums. - Chromium rendering of four demo tabs, nested sections, toggles, sliders, dropdowns, inputs, dialogs, popups, notifications and theme switching with zero page JavaScript errors. - The v2.0.1 change replaces the demo's Enable notifications checkbox with a rounded toggle and the system dropdown picker with an in-panel menu . Not verified / remaining differences - On-device Levi Launchroid 1.6.x and Minecraft injection, touch dispatch, overlay lifetime or activity switching. - Every WindUI advanced theme key affecting a visible element. - Accurate translation/localization, Roblox asset resolution, custom key binding across physical controllers, secure key validation, original acrylic/gradient/animation visuals. - Every configuration value receiving an observable GUI effect. Some builders are accepted and stored as metadata. - True native Minecraft GUI integration (current implementation is WebView). Troubleshooting The W button does not appear. Check launcher native-mod enablement, architecture and logcat for WindUI tags. Activity discovery uses InbuiltOverlayManager and may need adaptation to a newer launcher. The panel opens but is blank. Check Android WebView availability and JavaScript errors. The HTML and DEX are embedded in libWindUI.so . The module fails to load. Check libc++_shared.so and Android API 26 support. readelf -d dist/libWindUI.so shows its dynamic dependencies. A dropdown opens an Android full-screen list. That indicates an older v2.0.0 renderer containing <select> . Rebuild/replace with v2.0.1, where the dropdown uses buttons inside the WindUI scroll area. GetThemes() doesn't show your custom theme. Theme registration queues commands asynchronously, and C++ getters may reflect tracked state rather than a synchronous WebView query. Minecraft versions: "1.26. " , "1.26.6 " are the requested manifest strings, not evidence all listed versions were tested. Credits and license The project is MIT-licensed. WindUIBE is an independent Android adaptation inspired by and the Java/Dex loader approach of . Neither upstream project endorses this mod. See ATTRIBUTION.txt and LICENSE .
